title: urine good company at @New York City Center 🧻🚽 #urinetown #urinetownm...
transcript: the first time I saw urinetown I was 14 years old at summer camp and I don't think I quite understood what it was about until today or maybe it's just when I was a freshman in high school the musical felt ridiculous improbable instead of like foreshadowing when New York City Center announced that urinetown was part of their encores! season I don't think I really understood how much this is going to hit now in February of 2025 just a few weeks into our new administration UrineTown is a show we all need and new york city center is the perfect place to do it I am a New York City Center encores! Superfan and I feel like I say this every time but this might be my favorite encores show yet they just always lift the bar higher this production is almost fully staged they have a super fun set they have incredible choreography and costumes and obviously this cast Jordan Fisher Stephanie Styles Keala Settle and Rainn Wilson positively out of this world Jordan's Run Freedom Run made people jump to their feet side note if you do go see the show you have to go to the bathroom it's very fun urinetown is definitely a weird musical and because it isn't done often I feel like most people don't know anything about it the very brief synopsis urinetown is about a community that has experienced a drought and because of lack of water they no longer have private restrooms so corporations have come in bought up public restrooms and now charge people to use the bathroom and have bribed the government to make it illegal for people to go anywhere else I don't wanna spoil anything else but it does feel extremely relevant and it goes places you will totally never expect I was at invited dress the show already feels broadway ready I don't know if that's the plan but here's the thing I would not be mad about it
classificationReason: Creator attended the Encores! production of Urinetown at New York City Center (February 2025) and shares first-hand opinions on the cast, choreography, and production — but Urinetown 2025 does not appear on the provided show list.
